headline: AI-92 gasoline and diesel to continue to be subsidized until spring 2027
summary: Kyrgyzstan is proposing to extend state subsidies on imports and sales of AI-92 gasoline, diesel and automotive liquefied gas until 31 spring 2027. The proposal is pending.
why: Fuel subsidies affect domestic pump prices, state budget spending and the fiscal cost of energy imports for a landlocked, import-dependent economy.
original_headline: Бензин АИ-92 и дизель продолжат субсидировать до весны 2027 года
